about.full:
Hi, I’m **Shinas S**, a Computer Science graduate and **Full Stack AI Developer** passionate about building practical software and AI-powered applications.

I work across **Generative AI and full-stack development**, with hands-on experience in technologies such as *React, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, Express.js, Firebase, and OpenAI APIs*. I enjoy turning ideas into working products—from AI-powered chatbots and content-generation systems to mobile applications and full-stack platforms.

I’m particularly interested in **Generative AI, AI-assisted development**, and building products that solve real-world problems. I’m a curious learner who enjoys experimenting with new technologies, understanding how they work, and applying them to projects.

Currently, I’m focused on strengthening my skills in **Generative AI, backend development, system design, and AI application development**, while continuing to build and improve practical projects.

projects.title: NaaduX
projects.description:
Aether Media is a media processing tool that allows users to batch convert, compress, resize, and rename media files (video, audio, image) quickly, securely, and easily.

Built on the performance of Rust and the lightweight nature of Tauri. Using the power of FFmpeg in the background, it offers complex media operations with a modern interface. Your files are never uploaded to a server; all processes take place entirely locally on your own device.

projects.title: Urban Ease
projects.description: Urban Ease is a comprehensive marketplace platform designed to simplify local bookings for homes, appliances, and services. It provides a seamless user experience for discovering and booking quick, reliable, and affordable local offerings all in one centralized hub. Built with modern web technologies, it features secure payments, verified providers, and an intuitive interface that streamlines the entire booking process from search to confirmation.

projects.title: Book store Management
projects.description:
File Manager is a self-hosted file management application with a cyberpunk-inspired interface. It lets you upload, organize, tag, and filter any type of file through a sleek, modern web interface backed by SQLite — no external database required.

All files are stored locally on your machine — no cloud, no third-party servers. Upload your files, assign tags and keywords, and find them instantly with powerful filtering. The application automatically generates thumbnails for images and videos, giving you a visual overview of your entire archive.
